summary: Verified PAN/Aadhaar uniqueness enforcement on /auth/register. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass — anchor create/self-update (200), PAN conflict returns 409 with 'PAN already registered with us. Mobile: ******0004', Aadhaar conflict returns 409 with 'Aadhaar already registered with us. Mobile: ******0004', self-update excludes caller's own record (200), and fresh unique user still registers (200). Frontend E2E: with fresh mobile via OTP 123456, submitting profile with the anchor's PAN (QRSTU5678V) keeps the user on profile-card and renders the exact masked message inline under [data-testid=profile-pan] AND in a red toast. Same behavior confirmed for Aadhaar (999988887777) — inline error rendered under [data-testid=profile-aadhaar] with the exact string 'Aadhaar already registered with us. Mobile: ******0004'.
critical_code_review_comments: maskMobile helper handles null and short strings safely; format uses len(mobile)-4 stars + last 4 digits — matches spec exactly for 10-digit mobiles ('******0004').
Uniqueness check in AuthService.register uses findFirstByPanAndMobileNot / findFirstByAadhaarAndMobileNot correctly excluding caller by mobile — self-update works.
PAN is uppercased before comparison; aadhaar compared as-is (12-digit numeric, so case not applicable). Consistent.
Frontend ProfileForm.submit catch maps 'PAN'/'Aadhaar'/'Email' via case-insensitive regex to setErr and also fires toast — user gets both inline error and transient toast.
